split_rule: Town01 routes wholly at x <= 303.000 m are train; routes wholly at x >= 323.000 m are validation; Town02 is held out for validation; routes in the Town01 buffer are excluded

Town01.visibility_filter: project actor 3D bounding-box vertices; clip expected semantic tags to the resulting image rectangle; accept if bbox IoU >= 0.1, mask height > 25 px, and semantic-pixel fraction of projected rectangle > 0.15
Town01.rejected_visible_object_policy: if expected semantic pixels remain but acceptance thresholds fail, write their visible-pixel bounding box as IgnoreDontCare so it is excluded from background classification loss; candidates with no matching semantic pixels produce no ignore box
Town01.semantic_mask: semantic tags clipped to projected actor 3D bounding box; Pedestrians=12, Rider=13, Bicycle=19

Town02.visibility_filter: project actor 3D bounding-box vertices; clip expected semantic tags to the resulting image rectangle; accept if bbox IoU >= 0.1, mask height > 25 px, and semantic-pixel fraction of projected rectangle > 0.15
Town02.rejected_visible_object_policy: if expected semantic pixels remain but acceptance thresholds fail, write their visible-pixel bounding box as IgnoreDontCare so it is excluded from background classification loss; candidates with no matching semantic pixels produce no ignore box
Town02.semantic_mask: semantic tags clipped to projected actor 3D bounding box; Pedestrians=12, Rider=13, Bicycle=19

split_selection.strategy: Town01 complete routes assigned by X-region; Town02 held out for validation; episodes crossing the Town01 buffer are excluded
